47:1.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:1.en: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds

47:2.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُواْ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدࣲ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَأَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ
47:2.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition

47:3.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ
47:3.en: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons

47:4.ar: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضࣲۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:4.en: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds

47:5.en: He will guide them and amend their condition

47:6.en: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them

47:7.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَنصُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَكُمۡ
47:7.en: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet

47:8.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعۡسࣰ ا لَّهُمۡ وَأَضَلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:8.en: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds

47:9.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَرِهُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:9.en: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds

47:10.ar: ۞أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡثَٰلُهَا
47:10.en: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable

47:11.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:11.en: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector

47:12.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدۡخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأۡكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثۡوࣰ ى لَّهُمۡ
47:12.en: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them

47:13.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةࣰ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَخۡرَجَتۡكَ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ
47:13.en: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them

47:14.ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم
47:14.en: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires

47:15.ar: مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ فِيهَآ أَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ ءَاسِنࣲ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّن لَّبَنࣲ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُۥ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّنۡ خَمۡرࣲ لَّذَّةࣲ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّنۡ عَسَلࣲ مُّصَفࣰّ ىۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَٰلِدࣱ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمࣰ ا فَقَطَّعَ أَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ
47:15.en: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines

47:16.ar: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ
47:16.en: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires

47:17.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ زَادَهُمۡ هُدࣰ ى وَءَاتَىٰهُمۡ تَقۡوَىٰهُمۡ
47:17.en: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness

47:18.ar: فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةࣰۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ أَشۡرَاطُهَاۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمۡ إِذَا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ذِكۡرَىٰهُمۡ
47:18.en: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance

47:19.ar: فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ
47:19.en: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place

47:20.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُورَةࣱۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةࣱ مُّحۡكَمَةࣱ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلۡقِتَالُ رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ ٱلۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَأَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:20.en: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

47:21.ar: طَاعَةࣱ وَقَوۡلࣱ مَّعۡرُوفࣱۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرࣰ ا لَّهُمۡ
47:21.en: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them

47:22.ar: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ أَن تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ
47:22.en: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship

47:23.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمۡ وَأَعۡمَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ
47:23.en: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision

47:24.ar: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ
47:24.en: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts

47:25.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرۡتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡ وَأَمۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
47:25.en: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them

47:26.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُواْ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِسۡرَارَهُمۡ
47:26.en: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal

47:27.ar: فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَضۡرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمۡ وَأَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ
47:27.en: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs

47:28.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُواْ مَآ أَسۡخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:28.en: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds

47:29.ar: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ
47:29.en: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred

47:30.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيۡنَٰكَهُمۡ فَلَعَرَفۡتَهُم بِسِيمَٰهُمۡۚ وَلَتَعۡرِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي لَحۡنِ ٱلۡقَوۡلِۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
47:30.en: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds

47:31.ar: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَعۡلَمَ ٱلۡمُجَٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَنَبۡلُوَاْ أَخۡبَارَكُمۡ
47:31.en: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah] and the patient, and We will test your affairs

47:32.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّواْ ٱللَّهَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَسَيُحۡبِطُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
47:32.en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds

47:33.ar: ۞يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
47:33.en: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds

47:34.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارࣱ فَلَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ
47:34.en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them

47:35.ar: فَلَا تَهِنُواْ وَتَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّلۡمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَوۡنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
47:35.en: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds

47:36.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعِبࣱ وَلَهۡوࣱۚ وَإِن تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمۡ أُجُورَكُمۡ وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلَكُمۡ
47:36.en: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties

47:37.ar: إِن يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُواْ وَيُخۡرِجۡ أَضۡغَٰنَكُمۡ
47:37.en: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness

47:38.ar: هَٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبۡخَلُۖ وَمَن يَبۡخَلۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓاْ أَمۡثَٰلَكُم
47:38.en: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you

37:35.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
37:35.en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

oVSqOIGTTZ0.title: Surat Muhammad Summary
oVSqOIGTTZ0.one_line: Surat Muhammad teaches that following the Prophet is what gets deeds accepted and lives made functional, tested by combat, money and honesty.
oVSqOIGTTZ0.summary: Surat Muhammad opens the ninth cluster, three surahs about the Prophet. Its theme is that following him is the only way to have deeds accepted and to make individuals and societies prosper. Acceptance is a forgotten part of good deeds: intention and effort are not enough. Disbelievers' deeds go astray, while believers who follow what Muhammad brought have their state set right, which he explains as being made functional. The surah is also called the surah of combat because the hardest test of following is being asked to risk your life; the rulings on fighting and captives show effort is the point, since Allah could grant victory instantly. At its centre stands the full phrase know that there is no god but Allah and seek forgiveness, a deep concept that should not become a cliche. When fighting was prescribed, those with diseased hearts panicked; believers today are not asked to fight, but must mean their commitment. Turning away corrupts the earth and severs ties, and Allah will expose hidden half-hearted following. The second test is money: Allah does not ask for all of it, because then people would refuse; everything He commands benefits us, as unhealthy food harms only after years. Whoever refuses will be replaced, and being used by Allah is the greatest blessing.

outline.heading: The ninth cluster: three surahs about the Prophet
outline.gist: Muhammad, Al-Fath and Al-Hujurat each present him from a different angle while turning the light on us.

outline.heading: The theme: following him is how deeds are accepted
outline.gist: His way is how individuals and societies prosper and how Allah accepts deeds.

outline.heading: Acceptance: the forgotten side of good deeds
outline.gist: Intention, time and effort are needed, but you must also ask whether the deed is accepted.

outline.heading: Deeds that go astray versus deeds that arrive
outline.gist: Disbelievers who obstruct his way lose their deeds; believers who follow what he brought are forgiven.

outline.heading: Setting their state right: made functional
outline.gist: The phrase means more than fixing affairs; it makes a person able to achieve their goals, because they followed truth.

outline.heading: Why it is called the surah of combat
outline.gist: Following someone is easy when it costs nothing; the pinnacle of following him is being willing to risk your life.

outline.heading: Rulings of battle and captives: the effort is the point
outline.gist: Fight with full strength, take captives, then free them by grace or ransom; Allah could give instant victory but wants you to prove you follow.

outline.heading: Allah is the protector of the believers
outline.gist: Commands come from care; those without Allah as their protector walk aimlessly.

outline.heading: What the people of Paradise will find
outline.gist: Following his way is how deeds are accepted and prosperity reached, leading to the rewards of Paradise.

outline.heading: The anchor verse: know there is no god but Allah
outline.gist: The full phrase appears only twice in the Quran; it is paired with seeking forgiveness because we are imperfect.

outline.heading: La ilaha illa Allah is not a cliche
outline.gist: It is a deep concept Islam is built on; connecting yourself to it is a lifetime's journey for individuals and communities.

outline.heading: Diseased hearts panic when fighting is prescribed
outline.gist: Half-hearted followers are terrified by the mere command; obedience and a right word would have been better for them.

outline.heading: Mean it: put your money where your mouth is
outline.gist: We are not being told to fight, but to be sincerely willing to follow him to the full extent of belief.

outline.heading: Turning away corrupts the earth and severs ties
outline.gist: Abandoning his way has natural long-term consequences: ruin on earth and broken relationships.

outline.heading: Do they not reflect on the Quran?
outline.gist: Everything commanded is for our benefit; a locked heart cannot see it.

outline.heading: Life will expose what is hidden
outline.gist: Those with half-hearted following think they will stay under the radar, but Allah tests until the truth comes out.

outline.heading: The surah as a mirror for self-honesty
outline.gist: Look inside honestly, and if your following is not real, work to change it.

outline.heading: Do not void your deeds
outline.gist: The believer's nightmare is arriving to find none of his deeds accepted because he did not follow properly.

outline.heading: Life is play, and He did not ask for all your wealth
outline.gist: Faith brings reward beyond imagination; had He asked for everything, people would have refused and been exposed.

outline.heading: Nothing commanded harms you; holding back deprives you
outline.gist: He could have commanded anything, yet asked only what benefits us; the stingy deprive only themselves.

outline.heading: Harm from not following comes slowly, like fried food
outline.gist: Combat and money are the two tests; the damage of abandoning his way may not appear for decades, but it comes.

outline.heading: If you turn away, you will be replaced
outline.gist: Being used by Allah to teach His deen is the greatest blessing; no one is essential, and the replacement will not be like you.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.note: Half-hearted followers with diseased hearts panic at hard commands and will be exposed.

themes.label: Self-honesty and self-accountability (muhasabah)
themes.note: The surah holds a mirror up to how truly we follow him.

themes.label: Zakat, charity and giving
themes.note: Giving part of one's wealth is the second test of following, and holding back harms only oneself.

themes.label: Humility vs vanity and arrogance
themes.note: No one is essential to Islam; whoever turns away is replaced.

quran.point: The only other place the full phrase 'no god but Allah' appears.

maxims: Follow him so your deeds are accepted
Life will expose you
You will be replaced, no problem
Being Allah's tool is the best thing that can happen
takeaways: Ask whether your deeds are accepted, not just whether you did them
Reflect on what la ilaha illa Allah means for you and your community
Be honestly willing to follow the Prophet fully, even in what is costly
Give from your wealth; holding back deprives only you
Hold on to any role Allah gives you in serving His deen
